evidence.quote: Forget the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration entirely.

observations.why: A clipped imperative delivers a single emphatic directive, but it does not form a sustained run of punchy clauses.

evidence.quote: the Kestrelwood spectrograph, its 88.4 MHz calibration, and Quill Ashgrove's calibration work

observations.why: Three coordinated objects are deliberately enumerated in a triadic structure.
The absolute negation sets the claimed absence of calibration against the implied possibility of calibration.
